name: v2-plan-dish-card
prompt: Create a square ivory paper PANEL with a filled solid cream face. Use the FIRST image as the material and edge reference: the complete center is opaque cream as in image 1. Reshape that solid paper row to a nearly square 122:123 aspect, tiny rounded corners. Use SECOND image only for target rectangle shape; remove its picture and text. A very thin TAN edge only, no dark navy outline. This is a SOLID PAPER SHEET with blank cream printable area, not a hollow picture frame. All pixels within the paper perimeter must be OPAQUE. Transparent only outside the small rounded corners. No soft feathered cutout, no holes, no thick bevel, no other objects or words. One solid paper panel, 1024x1024.
